About this Event

🔥 BOLLYWOOD BHANGRA WITH BROWNY🔥
Presented by Tamasha NightsTamasha is the party that’s always packed and we’re bringing you another unforgettable night.
Get ready for Bollywood Bhnagra with Browny, a high-energy Desi nightlife experience where Bollywood, Bhangra, Afro, and Techno come together for one massive night on the dance floor.
🎧 DJ BROWNY from NYC
Known for bringing the energy with Bollywood and Punjabi anthems, Browny takes over the decks for a nonstop mix designed to keep you dancing all night.
Expect a packed crowd, big beats, desi anthems, global sounds, and the signature Tamasha energy that keeps Dallas coming back.

✨ WHAT TO EXPECT🔥 A packed Tamasha dance floor
🎧 DJ Browny bringing the Bollywood & Bhangra heat
💃 Dallas' Desi party crowd
🍸 Full bar & VIP bottle service
📸 Professional event photography
⚡ Nonstop music and high-energy vibes all night
Whether you're coming for the Bollywood bangers, Bhangra anthems, Afro beats, or late-night Techno, this is your night to dress up, show up, and turn up.
